column1: # The scenarios of tests/qemu/run.sh, one per line, in tab-separated columns:
#   name         the name, which run.sh takes as an argument
#   drivers      UEFI drivers on the ESP that the firmware loads before the kernel, in
#                order and separated by ";": a path, then optionally " " and its argument
#   variables    UEFI variables to create first: a JSON file of tests/qemu/vars in the
#   boots        the boots, separated by ",", which share one UEFI variable store: each is a
#                test binary of tests/qemu/guest/tests, then "/" and a libtest filter if any,
#                or "shell:" and a script of tests/qemu/shell, which the firmware's UEFI Shell
#   options      key=value tokens separated by single spaces, each key at most once, which
#                scenario-options.sh parses: kernel= how the scenario's Linux runs, "vamap" to
#                have it call SetVirtualAddressMap(), which run.sh sets up per architecture, or
#                "lockdown" and "lockdown-conf" to boot it with lockdown=integrity and
#                the Secure Boot firmware with its variable store in Setup Mode or, with keys
#                that run.sh generates for the scenario, in User Mode, or "default"; arch= a
#                comma list of the architectures that boot the scenario, of x86_64, i686 and
#                aarch64, which the others skip; devices= a comma list of QEMU devices to add,
#                of virtio-rng; guest= "unfixed" to boot the kernel of
#                guest-packages-<arch>-unfixed, or "unfixed-v5.8", with arch=x86_64, that of
#                params= a comma list of more kernel parameters of the Linux boots, such as
# The scenarios whose names start with "shell-" are those of make test-e2e-qemu-shell-<arch>.
